arms.role: EXACT_INFORMATION_NULL: the raw input is cropped to its last 60 rows before the extractor

baselines.train_constant: mean of the train labels of the 28 d tier; computed on the common evaluation set at closure, no fit, no terminal

benchmark_contract.checkpoint_selection: best validation MAE, patience 3 epochs, restored

comparability.against: the block's own baseline under one declared estimand

reference_evidence.why: no reference run root was given

comparability.why: every identity field matches (contrast declared on ['permitted_inputs']); the paper's metric is reported first

benchmark_contract.estimand: the part of the Q2_CONTEXT question a 30 GiB host can fit: does a causal daily-lag channel, or a deeper dilated core at W60, change error against the W60 baseline and against the W1440 exact-crop information null? The two W1440 FULL-DEPTH arms of Q2_CONTEXT (long_window_own_depth, long_window_local_support_67) are NOT in this block, so this block does NOT separate context from depth and does NOT answer the Q2_CONTEXT question: it measures the three arms whose retained cost pilots fit this host, and leaves the long-window treatment unmeasured
benchmark_contract.metric_aggregation: mean over 10020 evaluation origins, one horizon
benchmark_contract.metric_formula: MAE = mean |yhat - y| over the common evaluation set; MAE_z = MAE / sd_train
benchmark_contract.missing_policy: rows with a non-finite input withdrawn from the enumeration; nothing imputed
benchmark_contract.naive_baseline: persistence at the horizon, y(t), on identical origins
benchmark_contract.permitted_inputs: the 7 declared channels (6 features + the target's own history), window 60
benchmark_contract.scaler_fit_population: train windows (each row weighted by the windows containing it)
benchmark_contract.split_rule: DEV slice rows 1412361..1462761 (28 d train / 7 d validation) inside the family's train span; family test never read
benchmark_contract.target_construction: minute-averaged active power, kW, as published; not aggregated

daily_lag.how: a 4-channel calendar group adds one ARCH-A branch (detector + adapter) and 4 head/skip rows

capacity.initialization: every arm is built after set_random_seed(seed): arms of one seed are paired by seed, not weight-identical in their shared parts (a wider input changes the shapes and the draw order); the initial weights digest is recorded per cell

short_window_deep_core.how: a 4-channel calendar group adds one ARCH-A branch (detector + adapter) and 4 head/skip rows

common_evaluation_rule: the intersection over the block's arms of admissible validation origins, with a finite label and a finite daily lookup, derived at prepare BEFORE any score; every arm scores on it

factorial.informed_by: RESTRICTED BEFORE ANY SCORE from the arms of Q2_CONTEXT v1 (design 6d1aaecaf27c581c709a745a4f976c2e9dcc05594815b2ee1a9747595f4398b1, state BUDGET_LIMITED_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME, zero cells fitted), on the two RETAINED cost pilots' own measurements and on nothing else: long_window_own_depth 4.165 CPU s per update and 8 458 399 744 B peak RSS, long_window_local_support_67 4.443 CPU s per update and 10 279 276 544 B peak RSS, i.e. 17 507 s and 18 406 s per cell at the 4 000-update ceiling and a resident set that would take this host's memory away from its owner; the three arms kept cost 287 s, 312 s and 488 s per cell at the ceiling with peak RSS under 1 GiB. The restriction is a resource declaration made before any score of any cell existed, never a removal after a score was seen (reading rule 3); no arm, seed, recipe, scaler, row, cadence or ceiling of Q2_CONTEXT v1 is otherwise changed

question: the part of the Q2_CONTEXT question a 30 GiB host can fit: does a causal daily-lag channel, or a deeper dilated core at W60, change error against the W60 baseline and against the W1440 exact-crop information null? The two W1440 FULL-DEPTH arms of Q2_CONTEXT (long_window_own_depth, long_window_local_support_67) are NOT in this block, so this block does NOT separate context from depth and does NOT answer the Q2_CONTEXT question: it measures the three arms whose retained cost pilots fit this host, and leaves the long-window treatment unmeasured
reading_rules: three seeds on one task are development evidence
a fit that reached the update ceiling is CENSORED wherever its best checkpoint fell
no cell is removed after its score is seen
a published number under another protocol never enters the comparison column

recipe.monitor: validation MAE in scaled units (equals MAE_z with the common sigma)
recipe.role: HOUSEHOLD CONTINUITY REFERENCE (MAE+Adam) with validation in OBSERVED updates; it selects no trading loss

rows.reading: the panel is read from lo (pad + the widest volume tier before the DEV train span) to hi; origins are enumerated inside [train span, validation week] from row identities; padded rows are support only

scaler_rule: COMMON: the source run's train-only scaler (28 d, W60 windows) for every arm and tier; calendar channels mean 0 / sd 1; the lag channel takes the target's scaler; one evaluation sigma = the target's train sd
tier: TIER1: RP66-RP73 blocks: patience 3 events (600 non-improving updates)
train_population_why: the W1440 crop arm withdraws the train origins whose support reaches a padded row and the lag arm those whose daily lookup is non-finite; every arm of this block, the baseline included, trains on the SAME origins so an input difference is never conflated with volume
